However, the main way of using it is by the juice and pulp industry, generating large quantities of co-product, which is mainly used to make animal feed. Because it possesses phenolic compounds in its composition, the Cashew Peduncle Coproduct (CPC) is a promising material for the industry, considering these compounds that are extremely sensitive to oxidizing environments. In this way, it is necessary to use technologies to preserve them, allowing their application. The objective of the study was to obtain and characterize the physical, chemical and physicochemical parameters of the CPC phenolic extracts and to evaluate the use of the lyophilization process in the preservation of the antioxidant capacity through in vitro bioaccessibility analysis. The phenolic compounds were extracted by hydroalcoholic solution and ultrasonic bath from dry CPC. After obtaining the extract, the extract compounds were identified by UPLC-QTOF-MS Ultra Performance Liquid Chromatography. The extract was lyophilized using Maltodextrin (MD), Gum arabic (GA) and its blend (MD) as carrier agents. The extracts before and after lyophilization were evaluated for retention of phenolic compounds (CF) and their antioxidant activity (ABTS and FRAP). In the lyophilizates the physical characterization (solubility, hygroscopicity, water activity (Aw) and humidity), morphology (SEM) and crystallinity (XRD) were made. Finally, the bioaccessibility of the CF and AA contents was made in the non-lyophilized and lyophilized extracts. The results showed that the extraction process contributed to the increase of CF content (ranging from 243.32 \u00b1 14.2 in dry stalk to 376.25 \u00b1 12.3 mg GAE \/ 100 g in dry extract) and AA (12.01 \u00b1 1.5 in the dry peduncle for 70.35 \u00b1 2.01 \u03bcM Trolox \/ g in the dry basis extract). Non-lyophilized extract, quercetin, gallic acid and mirecetin, as well as its glycosides and derivatives, which may have contributed to the high AA, were also identified, as well as the presence of important phytochemicals for health in SPC. The use of the carrier agents allowed protection of the CF present in the extract, although a significant decrease of these compounds in lyophilized extracts was observed (ranging from 376.25 \u00b1 12.3 mg GAE \/ 100 g dry base in the non-lyophilized extract to 227.45 \u00b1 4.7 mg GAE \/ 100 g dry matter for MD). However, the amount of CF in the lyophilized samples did not differ, verifying that the two types of carrier agents used resulted in the same retention of these polyphenols. The results of AA showed that the highest values (178,03 \u00b1 2,5 and 168,12 \u00b1 3,7 \u03bcM Fe2SO4 \/ g of dry matter for MD and MG, respectively) by the FRAP method were of the samples with maltodextrin in the formulation. The powders presented high solubility (> 60%), low humidity (<8%), low Aw and hygroscopicity (<4%), desirable characteristics for dry products. As for the morphology, sawdust or broken glass was observed for lyophilized extracts, characteristic of the lyophilization process, besides a predominantly amorphous structure. The bioactivity of phenolic compounds (around 30%) and AA (below 10%) after digestion resulted in a protective effect of carrier agents, since a high reduction of these compounds was observed in the non-lyophilized extract . Therefore, the use of carrier agents associated with lyophilization for the protection of CPC phenolic extract makes it possible to suggest the use of these compounds by the nutraceutical or food industry and can be used as an additive in the food in order to prolong the useful life of products, such as because it has high antioxidant activity"]},{"id":"BRCRIS_0b96f5584c17bc5901a86e304e7e1eab","urls":[{"url":"https:\/\/sucupira.capes.gov.br\/sucupira\/public\/consultas\/coleta\/trabalhoConclusao\/viewTrabalhoConclusao.jsf?popup=true&id_trabalho=4511890","desc":"https:\/\/sucupira.capes.gov.br\/sucupira\/public\/consultas\/coleta\/trabalhoConclusao\/viewTrabalhoConclusao.jsf?popup=true&id_trabalho=4511890"}],"title":"EFEITO DO RES\u00cdDUO DO PROCESSAMENTO DO P\u00c9DUNCULO DO CAJU E DO \u00c1CIDO ASC\u00d3RBICO NA ESTABILIDADE OXIDATIVA DE DIFERENTES MATRIZES ALIMENTARES","publicationDates":["2016"],"summary":[]},{"id":"UCB-2_9e1c507cee69f0d608c5d24657808c79","urls":[{"url":"http:\/\/dspace.sti.ufcg.edu.br:8080\/jspui\/handle\/riufcg\/4104","desc":"http:\/\/dspace.sti.ufcg.edu.br:8080\/jspui\/handle\/riufcg\/4104"}],"title":"Processamento do ped\u00fanculo do caju em avan\u00e7ado est\u00e1dio de matura\u00e7\u00e3o: desidrata\u00e7\u00e3o osm\u00f3tica e secagem para elabora\u00e7\u00e3o de passas de caju.","publicationDates":["2006"],"summary":["Ped\u00fanculos de caju foram desidratados osmoticamente em xaropes com 50, 60 e 70 \u00baBrix seguidos de secagem a 50, 60 e 70 \u00baC em secador de bandejas a g\u00e1s Polidryer PD-25 e analisadas as suas caracter\u00edsticas f\u00edsico-qu\u00edmicas (a\u00e7\u00facares redutores, totais e n\u00e3o redutores, acidez, teor de \u00e1gua, vitamina C, pH e s\u00f3lidos sol\u00faveis) em cada etapa do processamento; microbiol\u00f3gicas (mofos, leveduras e coliformes fecais) do caju \u201cin natura\u201d e do produto seco; e sensoriais (apar\u00eancia, cor, aroma e sabor) das passas de caju. The processing of the cashew pseudo-fruit (also called peduncle) generates the main byproduct which represent up to 20% of the total weight of the pseudo-fruit. In the last years, studies verifying the prebiotic potential of the byproducts from the processing of the cashew peduncle are scarce or nonexistent. In this context, the present study aimed to evaluate in vitro the prebiotic effects of a lyophilized powder obtained from the byproduct of the cashew peduncle (named CAP) against different probiotic strains of Lactobacillus, such as: L. acidophillus LA-05, L. casei L-26 and L. paracasei L-10. The growth and viable cell numbers of the Lactobacillus strains were monitored in Mann, Rogosa and Sharpe (MRS) broth containing CAP (20 g\/L), glucose (20 g\/L) and fructooligosaccharides \u2013 FOS (20 g\/L), during 48 h. Some parameters related to the metabolic activity of the probiotic strains, cultivated in these different culture media, were evaluated, such as pH, production of organic acids and consumption of sugars. Similar viable cell count for each tested Lactobacillus strain in the different culture media were observed, count reached 8.5 - 9.0 log CFU\/mL and pH values at approximately 4.0 after 48 h of cultivation. The growth of these Lactobacillus strains in MRS broth containing glucose, FOS or CAP resulted in a decrease of pH, production of organic acids (acetic, citric, malic, formic and lactic) and consumption of sugars (glucose, fructose and maltose) during the incubation time, indicating an intense bacterial metabolic activity. Overall, the tested Lactobacillus strains showed similar capability to ferment the FOS and the CAP, although some differences related to the production of organic acids and consumption of sugars were detected. The results showed that the CAP possesses a prebiotic potential effect toward Lactobacillus strains. These findings may stimulate the agro-industrial sector to valorize the byproducts from the cashew pseudo-fruit processing as an added-value ingredient to the food industry."]},{"id":"BRCRIS_0f8e93f15843fbd071341f1d9af81cc0","urls":[{"url":"https:\/\/sucupira.capes.gov.br\/sucupira\/public\/consultas\/coleta\/trabalhoConclusao\/viewTrabalhoConclusao.jsf?popup=true&id_trabalho=3637497","desc":"https:\/\/sucupira.capes.gov.br\/sucupira\/public\/consultas\/coleta\/trabalhoConclusao\/viewTrabalhoConclusao.jsf?popup=true&id_trabalho=3637497"}],"title":"Avalia\u00e7\u00e3o in vitro do potencial prebi\u00f3tico de subproduto do processamento do ped\u00fanculo do caju (Anacardium occidentale L.) frente \u00e0 Lactobacillus spp.","publicationDates":["2016"],"summary":[]},{"id":"EMBRAPA-9_0821ee8dcc862f43dd7f9e82230f6665","urls":[{"url":"http:\/\/www.infoteca.cnptia.embrapa.br\/infoteca\/handle\/doc\/1025377","desc":"http:\/\/www.infoteca.cnptia.embrapa.br\/infoteca\/handle\/doc\/1025377"}],"title":"Processamento de castanha de caju.","publicationDates":["2006"],"summary":["Defini\u00e7\u00e3o do produto; Dentre as suas poss\u00edveis aplica\u00e7\u00f5es, destaca-se o seu uso como um corante alimentar, podendo vir a ser um substituto de corantes artificiais que s\u00e3o cada vez menos aceitos pelo consumidor. Por\u00e9m, o conhecimento de sua estabilidade frente ao armazenamento prolongado faz-se necess\u00e1rio, uma vez que os arotenoides \u2013 que s\u00e3o os componentes que conferem cor ao extrato \u2013 s\u00e3o reconhecidamente inst\u00e1veis, podendo vir a sofrer mudan\u00e7as em sua estrutura oxida\u00e7\u00f5es, polimeriza\u00e7\u00f5es, etc.), acarretando altera\u00e7\u00f5es de sua cor."]},{"id":"EMBRAPA-9_2ad7933beaff7240d0a9d9a78b9e3ccf","urls":[{"url":"http:\/\/www.infoteca.cnptia.embrapa.br\/infoteca\/handle\/doc\/1183072","desc":"http:\/\/www.infoteca.cnptia.embrapa.br\/infoteca\/handle\/doc\/1183072"}],"title":"Elabora\u00e7\u00e3o e an\u00e1lise sensorial de barras de caju submetidas a diferentes formas de desidrata\u00e7\u00e3o.","publicationDates":["2025"],"summary":["Visando ao desenvolvimento de produtos que representem alternativas de utiliza\u00e7\u00e3o da am\u00eandoa da castanha de caju e contribuam para a redu\u00e7\u00e3o do desperd\u00edcio do ped\u00fanculo, hoje estimado em mais de 940 mil toneladas\/ano. M\u00e9todos: Elaborou-se nove (9) formula\u00e7\u00f5es de barras de frutas, empregando-se diferentes processos de secagem de rodelas do ped\u00fanculo de caju submetido ou n\u00e3o \u00e0 pr\u00e9via desidrata\u00e7\u00e3o osm\u00f3tica. Foram utilizados caju liofilizado, caju saturado, secagem direta ao sol, secagem a ar em estufas e secagem em secador solar. Foram empregadas, ainda, na formula\u00e7\u00e3o, produtos como a farinha (f), xer\u00e9m (x) e gr\u00e2nulos (g), o \u00f3leo e a torta, todos ingredientes obtidos da am\u00eandoa de castanha de caju, bem como a fibra origin\u00e1ria da extra\u00e7\u00e3o do suco do caju, ap\u00f3s sucessivas lavagens e secagem para a sua prepara\u00e7\u00e3o. Utilizaram-se como fonte de carboidratos, mel de caju e de abelha, a\u00e7\u00facar mascavo e flocos de arroz. Resultados: O resultado da an\u00e1lise sensorial, realizada atrav\u00e9s de testes afetivos de localiza\u00e7\u00e3o central (TLC) com 100 provadores, permitiram concluir que os tr\u00eas tipos de barras elaborados com ped\u00fanculos de caju liofilizado, caju solar (ped\u00fanculos de caju secos em secador solar) e caju desidratado (ped\u00fanculos desidratados a ar quente em estufa), todos submetidos ao processo de desidrata\u00e7\u00e3o osm\u00f3tica a v\u00e1cuo (65\u00b0Brix\/40\u00b0C\/100min) antes da secagem, apresentaram melhor desempenho nos testes de aceita\u00e7\u00e3o sensorial para todos os atributos avaliados. Conclus\u00e3o: A viabilidade de se obter barras de frutas mediante o emprego de fonte de energia alternativa de baixo custo e que apresenta grande disponibilidade no Nordeste do Brasil, a exemplo da energia solar."]},{"id":"UECE-0_68d3681b5001b49d15dee291f3390200","urls":[{"url":"https:\/\/siduece.uece.br\/siduece\/trabalhoAcademicoPublico.jsf?id=78872","desc":"https:\/\/siduece.uece.br\/siduece\/trabalhoAcademicoPublico.jsf?id=78872"}],"title":"\"Uma revis\u00e3o sobre o caju (Anacardium occidentale L.): aspectos qu\u00edmicos e biol\u00f3gicos.","publicationDates":["2013"],"summary":["<div style=\"font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: medium;\"><font face=\"Arial, Verdana\"><span style=\"font-size: 13.3333px;\">O cajueiro \u00e9 difundido em quase todo territ\u00f3rio nacional, tendo as zonas costeiras do Nordeste como principal refer\u00eancia. Na natureza, h\u00e1 dois tipos de cajueiro os quais s\u00e3o definidos de acordo com sua caracter\u00edstica de porte, sendo denominados de cajueiro comum e cajueiro-an\u00e3o-precoce. Atrav\u00e9s do surgimento de clones de cajueiro-an\u00e3o-precoce, por apresentarem copa uniforme, melhoraram as pr\u00e1ticas de manejo, tais como a poda e o combate aos agentes externos (insetos), al\u00e9m da colheita do pseudofruto. A agroind\u00fastria de processamento do ped\u00fanculo e beneficiamento da castanha de caju aponta esse \u00faltimo, como principal respons\u00e1vel pela renda da fruta, a castanha. A castanha \u00e9 formada basicamente por casca (origem do l\u00edquido fen\u00f3lico popularmente conhecido como LCC), pel\u00edcula (onde s\u00e3o extra\u00eddos alcal\u00f3ides e taninos, sendo este \u00faltimo uma subst\u00e2ncia adstringente, com grande aplica\u00e7\u00e3o na ind\u00fastria qu\u00edmica) e am\u00eandoa (suas gorduras s\u00e3o compostas de \u00e1cidos graxos predominantemente monoinsaturados como o \u00e1cido ol\u00e9ico, que contribui na redu\u00e7\u00e3o do colesterol). Os principais constituintes do LCC s\u00e3o compostos fen\u00f3licos conhecidos por sua a\u00e7\u00e3o antioxidante e inibidora de radicais livres, tais como: \u00e1cido anac\u00e1rdico, cardanol e cardol. Com a grande variabilidade gen\u00e9tica existente, em v\u00e1rios clones de cajueiro, \u00e9 necess\u00e1rio selecionar os que atendam \u00e0s exig\u00eancias de comercializa\u00e7\u00e3o e industrializa\u00e7\u00e3o, j\u00e1 que neste caso os atributos qualitativos s\u00e3o mais importantes que os quantitativos. Vale ressaltar que o ped\u00fanculo apresenta um alto valor nutritivo, atrav\u00e9s do seu elevado teor de vitaminas e sais minerais, tais como c\u00e1lcio, ferro e f\u00f3sforo. O cajueiro (Anacardium occidental L.) e uma cultura nativa do Nordeste do Brasil. Em peso, o caju e composto por 10% de castanha e 90% de ped\u00fanculo. Destas, o ped\u00fanculo apresenta a menor percentagem de industrializa\u00e7\u00e3o. O objetivo deste trabalho foi estudar o processo de secagem dos res\u00edduos agroindustriais, do processamento do pseudofruto do caju, in natura e enriquecidos, com leveduras Saccharomyces cerevisiae visando o melhor armazenamento do produto final. O baga\u00e7o do ped\u00fanculo de caju foi fermentado com 12% (m\/m) de leveduras Saccharomyces cerevisiae a uma temperatura de 33\u00b0C utilizando um tempo de fermenta\u00e7\u00e3o de 24h. As isotermas de dessor\u00e7\u00e3o foram obtidas nas temperaturas de 20, 30, 40 e 50 \u00b0C A umidade de equil\u00edbrio foi determinada por gravimetria e as atividades, mediante o equipamento Novasina\u00ae. Os dados experimentais foram ajustados aos modelos de GAB e BET di e tri-param\u00e9trico. A escolha do melhor ajuste se deu, matematicamente, em fun\u00e7\u00e3o do coeficiente de determina\u00e7\u00e3o (R2) e do desvio m\u00e9dio relative (P); e qualitativamente atrav\u00e9s da distribui\u00e7\u00e3o residual. Foi observado que o comportamento higrosc\u00f3pico do baga\u00e7o de caju in natura difere significativamente do res\u00edduo enriquecido. O enriquecido apresenta menor afinidade pela \u00e1gua, provavelmente devido a presen\u00e7a de grupos hidrof\u00f3bicos na membrana do microrganismo, modifica\u00e7\u00f5es na composi\u00e7\u00e3o bem como, mudan\u00e7as estruturais e f\u00edsicas que acontecem durante a fermenta\u00e7\u00e3o. A \u00e1gua presente no enriquecido apresentou maior atividade que no baga\u00e7o in natura indicando menores forcas de intera\u00e7\u00e3o superficial. O baga\u00e7o de caju in natura apresentou teores nutricionais baixos que s\u00e3o melhorados com o processo de fermenta\u00e7\u00e3o semi-solida, observa-se aumento em quase todos os par\u00e2metros nutricionais. A equa\u00e7\u00e3o de GAB foi a que melhor se ajustou aos dados das isotermas de dessor\u00e7\u00e3o do caju, in natura e enriquecido. Observando que, quanto maior a presen\u00e7a de prote\u00ednas na formula\u00e7\u00e3o do baga\u00e7o de caju, menor a necessidade de energia para se remover \u00e1gua do produto, atrav\u00e9s da capacidade hidrof\u00f3bica de algumas prote\u00ednas e que apos o processo de enriquecimento, alem de estarem com maior quantidade ainda est\u00e3o mais est\u00e1veis pela proximidade do ponto isoel\u00e9trico destas, apos o processo de fermenta\u00e7\u00e3o. Observa-se que ambos os materiais, atingem umidade de equil\u00edbrio (bs) a aproximadamente 300 minutos. The aim of the present study was to assess the potential of industrial residues of cashew apples, with and without mineral fertilization, on the soil fertility, plant production and quality of fruits and apples of cashew nut adult plants in field conditions. In addition, it contains anacardic acids (AA), which although associated with positive biological effects, such as antitumor and antioxidant activity, have also been reported as toxic. The influence of 8 variables was evaluated: process time; storage temperature; pH; kind of packing; color of the package, in addition to the presence or absence of carboxymethylcellulose, cashew gum or lecithin. A rotational central composite design (RCCD) design was then carried out, in which the process temperature and pH were studied. The process temperature varied from 60 to 90 oC and the pH from 2.5 to 7.0 and the response variables were the color parameters. Concomitantly with the atomization, a lyophilization was carried out, which gave rise to a powdered extract without addition of encapsulants (CCE-L). Thus, CCE-L and CCE-L and CCE-M were evaluated in vivo for their zebrafish toxicity and in vitro for their antiproliferative activity [(glioma (U251), breast (MCF7), multidrug resistant ovary carcinoma (NCI\/ADR-RES), lung (NCI-H460), prostate (PC-3), ovary (OVCAR-3), colon (HT-29)], and antimicrobial [Escherichia coli (ATCC 25922), Salmonella Typhimurium (ATCC 51812), Listeria monocytogenes (ATCC 19115) and Staphylococcus aureus (ATCC 25923)]. The results showed that the steps of obtaining the CCE did not cause changes relevant to the final color of the CCE. Logo, o objetivo do presente trabalho foi avaliar o uso do baga\u00e7o de caju na cogera\u00e7\u00e3o de energia em uma planta piloto de produ\u00e7\u00e3o de etanol. Para tanto, o processo de cogera\u00e7\u00e3o foi simulado utilizando o software SuperPro Designer. A fim de se comparar os resultados, simulou-se o mesmo processo, contudo, utilizando baga\u00e7o de cana-de-a\u00e7\u00facar como mat\u00e9ria prima a ser utilizada na cogera\u00e7\u00e3o.
